question: In the orthogonal test, what is the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g?
question_long: In the orthogonal test of phenol removal by the alkali-fused gasification slag, what is the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g?
expect: (91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.57% (matches E1 of factor A in Table 3) (Table 2)
rendered:
To find the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g, we need to look at Table 2. The runs are: 

1. 0.25 g, 30 min, 30 °C, pH = 1, 0 mM H2O2 (removal rate = 91.95%)
2. 0.25 g, 60 min, 40 °C, pH = 3, 5 mM H2O2 (removal rate = 95.01%)
3. 0.25 g, 90 min, 55 °C, pH = 5, 10 mM H2O2 (removal rate = 88.94%)
4. 0.25 g, 120 min, 70 °C, pH = 7, 15 mM H2O2 (removal rate = 82.36%)

The mean removal rate is the sum of the removal rates divided by 4:

(91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.74%

So, the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g is 89.74%.
